C/F extraction: Regex dictionary for ten explicit symptom groups. A symptom is present when mentioned without local negation or historical cue; absent only with explicit local negation; unknown when missing, historical without a current cue, or conflicting. ‘No history of’ is unknown rather than current absence. Raw C/F text is never passed to a model.
radiology eligibility: Exclude the entire Radiology field on any subtype/glioma wording, diagnostic/differential language, other tumor/pathology wording, history/treatment wording, question mark, or missing text. Only safe-field structured observations enter C; unsafe/missing fields are unknown.

t1_signal.rule: T1 modality must be near a hypo/hyper/iso/heterogeneous descriptor.

t2_flair_signal.rule: T2 or FLAIR modality must be near a signal descriptor.

enhancement.rule: Explicit enhancement or negation; subtype categories retained only when text states ring-like/homogeneous/heterogeneous.

edema.rule: Explicit edema mention or local negation.

mass_effect.rule: Explicit mass-effect mention or local negation.

midline_shift.rule: Explicit midline shift mention or local negation.

cystic_component.rule: Explicit cyst/cystic mention or local negation.

calcification.rule: Explicit calcification mention or local negation.
